Saying #BlackLivesMatter isn’t enough: Demand that @amazon cut ties with police and ICE and end their complicity in police violence

Sign the petition from @mediajustice @freepress @MPower_Change @fightfortheftr + more: https://t.co/yxm2y1m1DM

Sign the petition: @mediajustice joining @conmijente to call on Univision and Telemundo to improve their coverage of #BlackLivesMatter on their Spanish-language stations. #LasVidasNegrasImportan  https://t.co/TCgcSkZjBy

And yet actions by platforms to tweak algorithms has often had the impact of suppressing Black dissent. 

So Gmail sending #BlackLivesMatter emails to promotions in only the latest hurdle. @Google, understand the history so you can stop repeating it #mediajustice
